That the accused has lend loan to Cw1, Cw6 to Cw8 by obtaining signatures of blank cheques, non-judicial stamp papers for security for exorbitant interest at the rate of 10% and the accused by misutilizing the blank signed papers of Cw1 created an agreement stating that Cw1 has sold the machineries of Nandi Enterprises belonged to Cw1 and on 07.02.2014 at 06.00 pm the accused went near the Nandi Enterprises situated at Sunkadakatte and tried to take away the machinery of said enterprises and when Cw1 questioned it the accused unlawfully restrained him, threatened him to do away his life.

8. My answer to the above points are as follows:
Point No.1 : In the Negative, Point No.2 : As per the final Order.
For the following, REASONS 9. Point No.1 : It is the case of the prosecution that, the accused has lend loan to Cw1, Cw6 to Cw8 by obtaining signatures of blank cheques, non-judicial stamp papers for security for exorbitant interest at the rate of 10% and the accused by misutilizing the blank signed papers of Cw1 created an agreement stating that Cw1 has sold the machineries of Nandi Enterprises belonged to Cw1 and on 07.02.2014 at 06.00 pm the accused went near the Nandi Enterprises situated at Sunkadakatte and tried to take away the machinery of said enterprises and when Cw1 questioned it the accused unlawfully restrained him, threatened him to do away his life.
10.
According to the prosecution PW-1 is the complainant / victim.
The prosecution has produced and got marked Ex.P.1 complaint, Ex.P.2 spot panchanama, Ex.P.3 to Ex.P.10 cheques.

11. In support of the case of prosecution it has examined Cw1 / Danappa M. Vali examined as Pw1,
who deposed before the court that he knows the accused since five six years.
One Veeranna introduced the accused to him about five six years back.
The complainant has obtained loan of Rs.3 lakhs from the accused.
At the time of lending the loan the accused has obtained signatures on eleven blank cheques and also obtained signatures of six non-judicial stamp papers.
He paid interest of Rs.30,000/- per month for three years.
On 07.02.2014 the accused along with rowdies came to the complainant and forced to repay the loan amount with interest and abused him with filthy language and forced to pay Rs.6 lakhs.
The accused tried to assault Cw1 and also tried to took away the machinery.
As such he has lodged complaint as per Ex.P.1.
On the next day the police have visited the spot and drawn stop panchanama as per Ex.P.2.
In the cross examination the witness stated that he has obtained hand loan from the accused and repaid the same.
Further the witness admitted that the accused has not obtained any blank cheques nor blank non-judicial stamp papers.

The witness further admitted that the accused has not received any interest from him nor unlawfully restrained him nor threatened him and he do not know the Danappa M Wali vs Narasimhamurthy on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135462268/
3 contents of Ex.P.1 complaint.

sentences.text: He has put his signature to the complaint prepared by the police.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence.
He put his signature to panchanama marked at Ex.P.2 at the police station.
The accused has not created any documents.

12. It is pertinent to note that even though Pw1 in his chief examination stated as per the case of the prosecution, but in the cross examination the witness clearly admitted that he has obtained hand loan from the accused and repaid the same.
The accused has not obtained any blank cheques nor blank non- judicial stamp papers.
The accused has not received any interest from him nor unlawfully restrained him nor threatened him and he do not know the contents of Ex.P.1 complaint.
He has put his signature to the complaint prepared by the police.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence.
He put his signature to panchanama marked at Ex.P.2 at the police station.
The accused has not created any documents.
As the complainant himself clearly admitted that the accused has not committed any of the offences as alleged by the prosecution in the cross examination.
As such the prosecution failed to prove its case beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
13. Point No.2:

In view of my findings on Point No.1 in the Negative, I proceed to pass the following:
:ORDER:
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C accused is hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under Section 341, 468, 471, 420, 506 of IPC & Sec.3, 4, 5 of Karnataka Prohibition of Charging Exorbitant Interest Act, 2004.
